title: Grandia: Prelude
native_title: グランディア ～プレリュード～
overview:
Grandia: Prelude is a not-for-sale promotional demo disc for Grandia, the role-playing game from Game Arts.

In Grandia, young Justin dreams of following in the footsteps of his late father, an adventurer. A spirit stone left to him hints that the legends of an ancient lost civilization are true, and with his friend Sue he sets out to uncover its secrets while the Garlyle forces hunt for the power sealed in the old ruins.

- Fully polygonal 3D environments
- Enemies are visible on the map, so fights can be avoided or started with a surprise attack
- Battles run on a timeline gauge, and well-timed moves can delay or cancel an enemy's attack
- Weapon skills and magic grow stronger with use
